# Stephen Ahier

Stephen Ahier is the current Deputy of [District 4](https://flow.je/elections/district-4) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Stephen Ahier has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stephen-ahier#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 3 & 4 with 35.7% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/steve-ahier-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WR29JfNOWF4)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nshSBMk_Mig)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stephen-ahier#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 4 with 42.5% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/steve-ahier/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-OnLixilLEQ)

Stephen Ahier has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 4](https://flow.je/elections/district-4). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/10/st-helier-deputy-seeks-third-term-as-polling-day-moves-closer/)\]

**Stephen Ahier was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 3 & 4 in 2018**.
